description: S83 mute conversation (recvOpt setting half, hermetic): drive l3_set_c2c_recv_opt on the seeded echo-peer conversation and prove recvOpt round-trips through l3_dump_state.conversations[].recvOpt (0=receive -> 2=mute -> 0). As of 2026-08 the tool no longer writes Prefs / the conversation cache itself: it calls the REAL getMessageManager().setC2CReceiveMessageOpt (the same SDK boundary the friend-profile Do-Not-Disturb switch hits) -> native DartSetC2CReceiveMessageOpt -> OnConversationChanged push -> C2CRecvOptCache -> _mapConv. So conversations[].recvOpt is now a PRODUCT projection, not the value the tool just wrote — the write and the read are different code, and an ABI/push regression fails this gate instead of hiding. recvOpt 2 is the exact value _shouldSuppress reads to suppress notifications (via C2CRecvOptCache.isMuted, with the conversation-list recvOpt as fallback). The first step waits for the conversation list to hydrate; ends restored to 0 so the fixture self-cleans. Hermetic — no echo round-trip; the OS-banner-absence half stays the two-process run_fixture_c_mute.sh. Maps to S83 (setting half).
